verdict.rationale: MoonPay's enterprise page says the platform can take incoming fiat bank transfers and automatically convert them into stablecoins through one API, with stablecoin minting and redemption infrastructure. That is a first-party fiat-to-stablecoin conversion capability, but it is described only in marketing copy, not in developer docs. The documented on-ramp and off-ramp flows are end-customer buy/sell widgets, not merchant treasury balance movements. Missing for 10: documented merchant fiat and stablecoin balances, internal transfer and rebalancing endpoints, dashboard rebalancing, end-to-end API documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can move value between fiat and stablecoin balances on the platform — internal transfers and rebalancing through the API or dashboard, documented end to end

citations.quote: automatically convert incoming fiat into stablecoins through one API platform.
Issue fiat-backed stablecoins with built-in minting, redemption, compliance, onboarding, and distribution infrastructure.
